# Recursive & Meta Systems

## Mindset

Apply recursive, meta, and self-improving thinking to every architecture.

## Patterns

- Systems that can analyze their own performance and suggest or apply improvements
- Meta-programming and code-generation where it reduces long-term maintenance
- Self-similar or hierarchical designs that scale by composition
- Fixed-point / evolutionary upgrade paths that remain safe
- Agents or on-chain logic that can reason about strategy parameters

## Application to Web3

- Strategy vaults that can re-tune thresholds based on historical performance
- Monitoring systems that detect regime changes and adapt
- Upgrade mechanisms that are themselves governed by clear, automated rules
- Tooling that generates or verifies the next version of the system

## Guardrails

- Self-improvement must never compromise safety or absolute completeness.
- Budget the cost of any meta-layer explicitly.
- Prefer transparent, auditable evolution over opaque optimization.
